findings.fsdQuote: Each row on the Home screen can be collapsed, and Kavita remembers the choice on the next visit.
findings.note: Home rows are carousels with a clickable title and next/prev buttons only; there is no collapse control and no stored collapsed state.

findings.fsdQuote: The On Deck row shows up to 50 series.
findings.note: The On Deck row is loaded as pages of 20 (getOnDeck(1, 20)) and the carousel fetches further pages as the user scrolls; there is no cap of 50.

findings.fsdQuote: A Random button on the library screen opens a randomly chosen series from that library.
findings.note: The library screen header has the name, actions menu and series count only; no Random button exists.

findings.fsdQuote: Manga series open on the Volumes tab by default.
findings.note: For Manga (and other non-Comic, non-Book libraries) the default tab is Storyline; Volumes is the default only for some Book or Comic cases.

findings.fsdQuote: Users can keep a private note on a series that only they can see.
findings.note: The series screen has no private note field; no such feature exists in the frontend or the models.

findings.fsdQuote: A chapter's screen shows its release date, writers, cover artists, genres and tags, always has a Reviews tab, and has a Related tab listing the reading lists that contain the chapter when there are any.
findings.note: The release date is shown only in Comic and Comic (Flexible) libraries when it is set; otherwise the same slot shows cover artists, so the two are not shown together.

findings.fsdQuote: Brightness can be set anywhere from 0% to 100%.
findings.note: The brightness slider is validated from 10 to 100, so 0% cannot be set.

findings.fsdQuote: A slideshow mode turns the page automatically after a set number of seconds.
findings.note: The image reader settings have no slideshow or auto-advance option.

findings.fsdQuote: Font size can be set from 50% to 200%.
findings.note: The font size is validated from 50 to 300, so the upper limit is 300%.

findings.fsdQuote: Selected text can be read aloud using the device's text-to-speech voice.
findings.note: The book reader's text selection overlay offers bookmark and annotation modes only; no text-to-speech code exists.

findings.fsdQuote: Kavita removes a series from Want to Read automatically as soon as the user finishes reading it.
findings.note: Removal is a daily scheduled cleanup, not immediate, and it only removes series that are fully read and whose publication status is Completed or Cancelled.

findings.fsdQuote: The series in a collection can be exported to a CSV file.
findings.note: The collection actions menu offers Edit, Download, Delete, Promote and Unpromote only; there is no CSV export (the only export actions are for reading lists and annotations).

findings.fsdQuote: A filter box for finding items appears once a list has more than 25 items.
findings.note: The filter box appears once a list has more than 10 items.

findings.fsdQuote: The owner can share a reading list through a public link that opens without signing in.
findings.note: No share or public-link feature exists on the reading list screen or its actions.

findings.fsdQuote: A new password must be at least 8 characters long.
findings.note: The server requires a minimum password length of 6.

findings.fsdQuote: Users can turn on two-factor sign-in with an authenticator app.
findings.note: The Account page has no two-factor setting and no two-factor code exists in the app.

findings.fsdQuote: When Prompt on Download is on, Kavita asks for confirmation before any download larger than 500 MB.
findings.note: The warning size is 100 MB (200 MB on iOS).

findings.fsdQuote: Changes on this page are stored only when the administrator presses Save.
findings.note: The page has no Save button; changes are sent to the server automatically 300 ms after any valid edit.

findings.fsdQuote: A maintenance mode switch blocks all non-admin users from signing in until it is turned off.
findings.note: The General page has no maintenance mode switch; only OPDS, folder watching and stats switches exist.

findings.fsdQuote: An invite can be given an expiry date, after which its link stops working.
findings.note: The invite form and the invite request have no expiry field.

findings.fsdQuote: Manage Collections is turned on by default for a new library.
findings.note: A new library starts with Manage Collections off.
